method: rank fixture ids by sha256('round2:'+id) ascending, take the first 10 (~20%)
why: A FRESH DRAW. Round 1 reused the same ten ids for its second labeller, so the disagreement rate re-measured a question D-021 had already settled — found independently by the corpus and ablation reviewers (A-028). Salting the hash keeps the selection deterministic and unsteerable while making it a genuinely new sample.
